title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache + parallelism
description: Motivation: CI pipelines have grown monolithic and slow, causing longer feedback loops and flaky cache hits. This PR splits the single large CI workflow into dedicated lint, test, and release pipelines, consolidates caching steps, upgrades several GitHub Actions to recommended versions, and tunes job matrix and parallelism to reduce queue times. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml and deprecate the monorepo workflow. 2) Centralize cache key generation to use node-modules + lockfile + GH action cache version var to improve hit rate across matrices. 3) Reduce unnecessary matrix axes (platform/job combos) and add fast-fail grouping for lint->typecheck. 4) Upgrade actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 and cachix/action-cache@v3, and pin hashes where applicable. 5) Add small runner-resource hints for large integration tests and split heavy e2e into staged jobs. Backwards compatibility: release automation kept intact (release.yml uses the previous release action but in a smaller workflow). Testing: validated on fork and in repo with trial run; observed ~35% median reduction in CI wall time for common PR sizes and improved cache hit rate on repeated runs. Rollout plan: merge to main, keep old monolithic workflow disabled for 48h with a short feature flag to revert job triggers if regressions observed. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows created - [x] Cache key logic unified - [x] Actions upgraded and pinned - [x] Integration tests run on branch - [x] Observability: added pipeline telemetry tags for new workflows - [x] Release automation validated. See linked Linear tickets for follow-up cleanup tasks.
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Refactor CI: split monolithic workflow into lint/test/release workflows, improve cache hit rates, and upgrade GitHub Actions. Expected faster CI feedback and more reliable caching. No behavioral changes to production release automation.

diff_snippets:
- name: Checkout code
  uses: actions/checkout@v3
+ name: Checkout code
  uses: actions/checkout@v4
  with:
    fetch-depth: 0

- cache-key: npm-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
+ cache-key: npm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}-v2

- matrix: os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest] node: [16,18]
+ matrix: os: [ubuntu-latest] node: [18] # reduce axes for faster queues

Ava Chen: Responded - unified cache key to include runner.os and bumped cache version variable. Pinned setup-node to v4 and pinned commit hash for checkout where available.
Priya Nair: Requested adding telemetry tags to distinguish lint/test/release pipelines in our observability stack.
Ava Chen: Added telemetry tags and documented them in docs/ci.md.
Liam O'Connor: Approved after one nit about matrix reduction; verified ~30-40% median CI time reduction in quick experiments.
notes_for_ops: After merge keep old ci-monolith workflow disabled for 48 hours, monitor CI queue time and cache hit metrics in Datadog. If cache hit rate drops by >10% or pipeline failures increase, revert by re-enabling ci-monolith and open follow-up ENG ticket.
